_meta.purpose: Stage 5 draft `openables` array for src/data/locations/<id>.location.json — the minimal Ultima VII container verb. 12 objects across the 5 plates, every one of them anchored to a prop that is ALREADY PAINTED on the shipped plate.
_meta.coordinateSpace: NATIVE 640x360 px. `anchor` is the painted prop's own {x,y} from plateProps (or the loreObjects entry). `approach` is where the player must stand; it is an ORIGIN point and was verified walkable at (x, y+15) against the location's walk mask.
_meta.designRule: An openable is NOT a new prop. It is a flag on a prop that already exists, plus contents, plus two lines of prose. The whole feature ships without a single new sprite — the only art cost is an optional 2-frame open/closed state per prop TYPE (8 types below), and the Tier-0 fallback is no state change at all plus a notification.

schema.prop: the plateProps.key or loreObjects.id it hangs on. MUST exist.
schema.label: verb-phrase shown on the interaction prompt
schema.contents: array of { itemId, count } | { money } | { flag } | null
schema.emptyText: one line, shown when the container has already been emptied. This is the line the player will read most often — it is the writing that matters.
schema.witnessed: true = opening while ambient crowd or a named NPC is within 80 native px and in daylight sets `petty-theft-witnessed`
schema.reopenable: true = a container that refills or is simply a place to look (wells, coops); false = one-shot

_meta.note: Prop prose quoted in `_examine` below is the SHIPPED examineText from the location file, reproduced so the writer of the openable text can match its voice.

waterfront.label: Force the ledger drawer
waterfront._note: THE quest openable. src/data/quests/merchants-seal.json theft-success objective is {type:'search', target:'counting-house-drawer'} — this is that target, given a body. Anchor moves to (596,296) once the counting-house building module lands (dependencies D1).
waterfront._examine: Every bale on this quay is written into a ledger inside, in Portuguese, from a tally kept in Chinese, of goods measured in Malay bahar. Three chances to disagree.
waterfront._lockNote: Not lockpicked — the lock is the guard and the door. Once inside, the drawer opens. Second attempt requires `key-warehouse` for the barred shutter, not for the drawer.

onOpen.notification: The seal is cold in your hand.

waterfront.emptyText: The drawer runs on beeswax and does not squeak, which you noticed at the time and have thought about since.

waterfront.label: Open the bonded chest
waterfront._propSource: waterfront.location.json loreObjects; prose in src/data/historical-objects.json — 'A locked chest used to secure goods that have entered bonded storage.'
waterfront._lockNote: key-warehouse already exists in the world at a-famosa-gate.location.json items[1] (184,307) and has never had a lock to fit. This gives the shipped key a shipped door.

onOpen.notification: Duty paid on paper, and thirty cruzados that were not on the paper.

waterfront.emptyText: Sound wood, sound iron, and a smell of pepper that will outlast the chest.

waterfront.label: Try the barred door
waterfront._examine: Tin ingots from Perak, stacked like loaves. The door is barred and the bar is new.
waterfront._lockNote: Key AND standing. Alvares's tin under bond is not a thing you walk into with a borrowed key and no reason.

onOpen.notification: Sixty bahar on the manifest. You count fifty-four stacks and stop counting.

waterfront.emptyText: The bar goes back across easily. It is a new bar and it has not yet learned to stick.

waterfront.label: Look in the open cask
waterfront._examine: An open cask, half full of brackish water.

onOpen.notification: Two cruzados in the sediment. Somebody was hiding them or somebody was drunk.

waterfront.emptyText: Rainwater, a drowned gecko, and the reflection of a man who checks casks.

waterfront.label: Prise open the crate
waterfront._examine: A pine crate stencilled with a merchant's mark.

onOpen.notification: Nutmeg, still in its mace. Somebody will notice the lid.

waterfront.emptyText: The lid sits crooked now. It will sit crooked until it reaches Goa.

rua-direita.label: Open the warehouse strongbox
rua-direita._note: The Gomes warehouse container. It sits in the warehouse yard beside the `warehouse-side` door (rua-direita.location.json doors[2], 236,144), the door his 07:00 schedule slot enters through. His shipped `rest` topic — 'my warehouse has a clean cot' — establishes that the player is welcome in this yard, which is what makes the strongbox a moral question rather than a lock.

onOpen.notification: Twelve cruzados, a manifest, and three voyages entered where he told you there was one.
onOpen._note: SETS UP the investigate-truth path without spoiling it: the player who opens this box has physically seen what Rashid's `gomes-debt` override tells them later. If `saw-gomes-books` is set, the truth-confrontation stage should offer a harder opening line.

rua-direita.emptyText: He does not lock it. That is either trust or the certainty that nobody would dare, and after this week you are no longer sure which.

rua-direita.label: Open the tally crates
rua-direita._examine: Crates stacked two high, roped against the rain.
rua-direita._lockNote: Opening these while under Alvares's tally contract is the JOB. Opening them without it is theft and `witnessed` will catch it — the cooper resident stands 44px away from 07:00 to 18:00.

onOpen.notification: Ingot, mark, weight. Ingot, mark, weight. Forty cruzados is beginning to look like a wage rather than a gift.

rua-direita.emptyText: Roped again, exactly as you found them. He will check the knots.

rua-direita.label: Search the handcart
rua-direita._examine: A two-wheeled handcart, shafts resting on the cobbles.

onOpen.notification: A copy of a copy, in a fine upright secretary hand — and the fee column leaning.

rua-direita._note: Diogo Almeida's `handwriting` topic verbatim: 'Senhor Mesquita writes a fine upright secretary hand, very even - except in the fee column, where the letters lean.' Finding it in a cart before Diogo says it makes his line land as confirmation instead of exposition.
rua-direita.emptyText: Straw, a broken seal-wafer, and the smell of somebody else's morning.

rua-direita.label: Open the coop

onOpen.notification: Two eggs, and one hen now loose on Rua Direita.
onOpen._note: Spawns a `crowd-malay-child` chasing a chicken sprite along the `near-pavement` crowd path for 60s. Aminah gets a one-off bark. This is the only joke in the openables set and it should be the only one.

rua-direita.emptyText: The hen has not forgiven you and neither, apparently, has the street.

a-famosa-gate.label: Open the powder barrels

onOpen.notification: Serpentine powder, badly stored. A sentry is already walking toward you.
onOpen._note: The one openable in the game that is purely a trap. Rodrigues's `duty` and `garrison` topics establish exactly how he would take this. It costs the player nothing they need and 20 points of the faction whose Capitão gates the diplomatic path — which is a lesson, not a wall.

a-famosa-gate.emptyText: Somebody has put a new seal on the head since you last looked at it. You are fairly sure that is about you.

a-famosa-gate.label: Open the stall box

onOpen.notification: Five cruzados in small coin, under a folded cloth.

a-famosa-gate.emptyText: String, a comb, a tin cup, and the day's takings gone somewhere sensible.

st-pauls-church.label: Haul up the bucket

onOpen.notification: Somebody's rosary, down there long enough to have gone green.
onOpen._note: st-pauls-church.location.json already places a `rosary` world item at (290,307), eight pixels from the well. Move that item INTO the bucket instead of leaving it lying on the flagstones, and the plate stops looking like a shop floor.

st-pauls-church.emptyText: Cold, and further down than the hill suggests. The rope is longer than the church is tall.

kampung.label: Unroll the mats

onOpen.notification: Tongkat ali, kacip fatimah, misai kucing — bundled, labelled in a hand you cannot read.
onOpen._note: Mak Enang's `healing` topic names those three plants exactly. Finding them named and bundled before she explains them is the difference between lore and a world.

kampung.emptyText: Rolled and tied the way she ties them, which is not the way you tied them.

kampung.label: Open the coop

onOpen.notification: Three eggs, still warm. In the kampung this is not theft unless you take all of them.

kampung.emptyText: Empty this morning, and the hens have an opinion about who is responsible.

_itemsRequired.status: NEW — needs a definition in the item table and a 16x16 icon. Value 1 cruzado. See dependencies D7.
exists — a-famosa-gate.location.json items[1], currently unlocks nothing

_openStateFallback: Tier-0: no sprite change at all. The prompt reads 'Open the X', the notification fires, and the label flips to the emptyText on subsequent examines. Tier-1: a 1-frame lid-ajar variant per prop TYPE (12 sprites, all reusable across every instance of that type on every plate). Tier-2: a 2-frame open animation. The set is worth shipping at Tier-0 on day one; the value is in the contents and the prose, not the hinge.
